_doc: Data of scripts/ci/joinability.mjs. tables.<t>.textColumns/arrayColumns are pinned by `joinability.mjs --pin` from information_schema (read-only); unmapped maps a pinned column to what it is. classes declares, per couplings.json class, the surfaces it sits on and which of modes, relations and reach are required.

pinned.method: information_schema.columns, BEGIN READ ONLY; data_type text, character varying or ARRAY of them

instrument.basis: obligation_objects and statutory_computations (facts.json surface regulations) are filed under instruments

mandate.basis: a consignment-wide mandate is an instrument (obligation_objects, regulations)

feedstock.basis: feedstock prices are market_series (facts.json surface market)

carrier.basis: oem_tech_roadmaps (market) maps to carriers; research_assessments_current (research) files technologies under them

node.basis: grid_connection_queues (operations) files under node:grid_queues; oem_tech_roadmaps (market) maps charging and reefer nodes; research files technologies

hub.basis: a hub is a port or airport a node serves (operations)

mode.basis: a mode is a lens on every surface, never a surface of its own

attribute.reason: a quantitative attribute is a measurement lens (class kind method): it carries a unit, not a mode or a relation

window.reason: a time window is a horizon definition (class kind method): it is filed by date, not by mode or relation

absences.reason: ukpn-capacity-heatmap publishes demand_firm, demand_available and a GREEN/AMBER/RED constraint per substation and no queue duration; the producer stores null with obs_status L (missing) by ruling 2026-10-08 and never a typed number
the cited capture does not state a target year for the row; the rows file says so per row (absent.target_year)

unmapped.claim_kind: the claim's kind token (GAP, ANALYSIS, DERIVED and the rest); read as the ref role by the claim pass, not an entity
unmapped.claim_text: the verbatim-grounded claim sentence; read for formal codes (an instrument identifier, a UN/LOCODE) by src/core/coupling/refs.ts claimRefs, no word of it is matched
unmapped.mint_hold_reason: why a minted claim was held back; workflow housekeeping prose
unmapped.source_span: the verbatim span of the capture the claim is grounded on; provenance text, the claim text is what is resolved

unmapped.binding_position: binding-position token (vocabularies.json binding_position); a vocabulary token checked by J3
unmapped.cost_formula: the cost formula the span states, verbatim; prose the statutory computation reads, not an entity
unmapped.duty_holder_class: duty-holder class tokens (vocabularies.json duty_holder_class); a vocabulary token checked by J3
unmapped.evidence_required: prose describing the evidence a duty requires
unmapped.frequency: how often the duty recurs, as stated; a prose label
unmapped.mandated_unit: the unit of the mandated quantity; a unit token normalised by statutoryUnit (J3), not an entity
unmapped.method_version: version string of the writer of the row (derived or reader@kinds); provenance housekeeping
unmapped.obligation_id: the obligation's own text key (primary key); an identifier, filed in entity_refs by its uuid
unmapped.pinpoint_citation: the article or paragraph the duty is cited to; a citation label of the instrument already joined through instrument_entity_id
unmapped.plain_language: plain-language restatement of the duty; prose derived from the verbatim text, which is the column resolved
unmapped.retention_period: how long records are kept, as stated; prose
unmapped.sanction_class: sanction class token of the duty; a classification label
unmapped.status: workflow or publication status word of the row; a lifecycle token
unmapped.statutory_maximum: the verbatim penalty or ceiling fragment whose unit and figure are read by statutoryUnit and findFigures (J3 unit column)
unmapped.supersedes: obligation_id of the obligation this one supersedes; a self-reference of the obligation table, not an entity
unmapped.verbatim_text: the verbatim duty text; read for formal codes (CELEX and instrument numbers) and its figures through statutoryUnit, no word of it is matched
unmapped.vertical: customer-vertical tokens (vocabulary-verticals); a lens the reader filters by, never an entity of the coupling vocabulary

unmapped.formula_version: version string of the statutory formula; housekeeping
unmapped.result_unit: unit of the computed result; a unit token normalised by statutoryUnit (J3)
unmapped.unit_price_unit: unit of the unit price; a unit token normalised by statutoryUnit (J3)

unmapped.commercial_stage: commercial-stage token (announced to mass_series_production) read by the maturity assessment; its vocabulary is checked by J3
unmapped.confidence_admiralty: Admiralty-code source and information grade (A1 to F6) of the row; a provenance grade, not an entity
unmapped.density_basis: cell, module or pack basis of the stated energy density; a qualifier token of the figure
unmapped.derivation: provenance token (vocabularies.json derivation) saying how the value was derived; a vocabulary token checked by J3, not an entity
unmapped.origin_class: provenance token (vocabularies.json origin_class) saying how the row was obtained; a vocabulary token checked by J3, not a thing to join on
unmapped.tech_category: the technology category token of the roadmap row (a vocabulary word); it maps to no entity in the engine (NO-ENTITY-LISTS-1: no word-to-entity table), so a roadmap is filed by a Reader's ref or its manufacturer_id entity column

unmapped.capacity_band_mw: the capacity band as published, in MW (a constant unit, J3 part ii); a quantity label, not an entity
unmapped.confidence_admiralty: Admiralty-code source and information grade (A1 to F6) of the row; a provenance grade, not an entity
unmapped.demand_constraint: the operator's GREEN, AMBER or RED demand constraint; a status token
unmapped.demand_constraint_limiting_factor: the operator's stated limiting factor; free-text label
unmapped.derivation: provenance token (vocabularies.json derivation) saying how the value was derived; a vocabulary token checked by J3, not an entity
unmapped.dso_name: the network operator's published name; the flywheel matches no free-text words, so the entity comes from the row's entity_id or a formal-code map, never from this label (operator 2026-10-25)
unmapped.obs_status: SDMX observation-status token (vocabularies.json obs_status) of the row; a vocabulary token checked by J3, not an entity
unmapped.origin_class: provenance token (vocabularies.json origin_class) saying how the row was obtained; a vocabulary token checked by J3, not a thing to join on
unmapped.substation_name: the substation's own name; the table is filed under node:grid_queues by the const map, no per-substation entity exists
unmapped.substation_ref: the operator's substation reference (mRID); an upstream identifier

unmapped.currency: ISO 4217 currency code of the value; a unit token (J3 reads units), not an entity
unmapped.derivation: provenance token (vocabularies.json derivation) saying how the value was derived; a vocabulary token checked by J3, not an entity
unmapped.dimension: classification label of the fact (labor_markets, operational_cost); a label, not an entity
unmapped.fact_label: the prose label of the row; the flywheel matches no free-text words, so the entity comes from the row's entity_id or a formal-code map, never from this label (operator 2026-10-25)
unmapped.method_version: version string of the method that computed the row; provenance housekeeping
unmapped.origin_class: provenance token (vocabularies.json origin_class) saying how the row was obtained; a vocabulary token checked by J3, not a thing to join on
unmapped.reference_period: the period the observation covers as published (a date label); a time label the series key already carries
unmapped.source_key: the producer's key for the upstream series or feed; provenance housekeeping, the source is joined through source_id
unmapped.source_note: free-text note on where the figure came from; prose provenance
unmapped.source_ref: the upstream record reference at the publisher; provenance housekeeping
unmapped.status: workflow or publication status word of the row; a lifecycle token
unmapped.trend: direction word of the published value (up, down, flat); a display token
unmapped.unit: the unit of the row's value as published; a unit token normalised by statutoryUnit (J3), not an entity
unmapped.value: the value as published, text form of value_numeric; the figure is read from the typed column

unmapped.currency: ISO 4217 currency code of the value; a unit token (J3 reads units), not an entity
unmapped.derivation: provenance token (vocabularies.json derivation) saying how the value was derived; a vocabulary token checked by J3, not an entity
unmapped.label: the prose label of the row; the flywheel matches no free-text words, so the entity comes from the row's entity_id or a formal-code map, never from this label (operator 2026-10-25)
unmapped.series_key: the producer's formal series code (an upstream key such as a feed id and product code); it maps to no entity in the engine (NO-ENTITY-LISTS-1: no word-to-entity table), so a series is filed only by its typed entity_id column or by a Reader's ref
unmapped.method_version: version string of the method that computed the row; provenance housekeeping
unmapped.origin_class: provenance token (vocabularies.json origin_class) saying how the row was obtained; a vocabulary token checked by J3, not a thing to join on

unmapped.unit: the unit of the row's value as published; a unit token normalised by statutoryUnit (J3), not an entity

unmapped.confidence: extractor confidence token of the dated event; a grade
unmapped.date_precision: precision of the event date (day, month, year); a qualifier token
unmapped.event_kind: trigger-kind token (phase_step, implementing_act_due and the rest) read by the lead-lag detector through facts.json kind; a vocabulary of patterns.json
unmapped.extractor_version: version string of the extractor that wrote the event; housekeeping
unmapped.resolved_span: verbatim span of the capture that resolved the event; provenance text
unmapped.source_kind: what kind of source span the event came from; a provenance token
unmapped.source_span: verbatim span the event was extracted from; provenance text

unmapped.commercial_maturity_evidence_ids: ids of the evidence rows behind the commercial maturity band; foreign keys, not entities
unmapped.commercial_maturity_method: method token of the commercial maturity band; housekeeping
unmapped.computed_by: name of the job or method that wrote the row; provenance housekeeping
unmapped.credibility_evidence_score: credibility evidence score grade of the assessment; a grade
unmapped.horizon_band: horizon band token (2-6 months, 6-18 months); a time band, its vocabulary is checked by J3
unmapped.horizon_confidence: confidence grade of the horizon band
unmapped.horizon_kind: horizon kind token; its vocabulary is checked by J3
unmapped.horizon_rule: the rule that placed the horizon band; housekeeping
unmapped.horizon_trigger_note: prose naming what would move the horizon; free text
unmapped.lifecycle_state: lifecycle token of the row (current, superseded, withdrawn); housekeeping
unmapped.refusal_reason: why no assessment was produced (no_dated_basis and the rest); a reason token
unmapped.status_token: rule-14 status token (CONFIRMED, HYPOTHESIS, REFUTED) of the row; a verification label
unmapped.technical_maturity_evidence_ids: ids of the evidence rows behind the technical maturity band; foreign keys, not entities
unmapped.technical_maturity_method: method token of the technical maturity band; housekeeping

unmapped.cause: the prose label of the row; the flywheel matches no free-text words, so the entity comes from the row's entity_id or a formal-code map, never from this label (operator 2026-10-25)

unmapped.admissibility: admissibility token (analysis_ok, display_only, stale); a grade of the value
